name: brand-comparison
note: Mapping who an answer engine cites when asked to compare named Ayurvedic products against the classical formulary, or to state a composition with quantities. Not a measure of our own standing: nothing of this kind has been published here yet. The four families are deliberate: composition-with-quantities and formulary-verification are questions that turn on a figure and a citation; cross-brand questions are ones no single manufacturer can answer about itself; the head-term family is a control expected to lose to the brand's own page, so that the difference between the two kinds of question is visible in the data rather than argued about.
